# Mountain's Edge Homes - Dr. Jan Duffy, REALTOR

> Mountain's Edge is a master-planned community in southwest Las Vegas, in unincorporated Enterprise (Clark County), ZIP 89178. This site covers its neighborhoods, parks and buyer resources.
